text.en: 1. These Rules may be cited as the Parking Places (Coupon Parking) Rules.

2. In these Rules, unless the context otherwise requires —
“coupon parking place” or “parking place” means a parking place designated by the Superintendent in accordance with rule 5(1) as a place where vehicles may be parked using parking coupons;
[Deleted by S 530/2026 wef 03/08/2026]
“parking coupon” or “coupon” means a coupon or other document issued by the Superintendent to any person for the purpose of parking a vehicle in accordance with rule 9;
“parking charge” means the parking charge fixed under section 9(1) of the Act.
[S 278/2018 wef 01/05/2018]
[Deleted by S 278/2018 wef 01/05/2018]

3. The Parking Places Rules (R 2) shall apply to vehicles parked in a coupon parking place in so far as any of the provisions of those Rules is not inconsistent with or modified by the provisions of these Rules.

3A. A person must not park a vehicle in any coupon parking place at any period of time during which parking charges are payable unless the parking charges for that period is paid by —
(a)the method described in these Rules;
(b)the method described in rule 4 or 4A of the Parking Places (Digital Payment — Parking Charges) Rules 2022 (G.N. No. S 76/2022); or
[S 530/2026 wef 03/08/2026]
(c)a combination of those methods.
[S 554/2017 wef 03/10/2017]
[S 278/2018 wef 01/05/2018]
[S 530/2026 wef 03/08/2026]

5.—(1) The Superintendent may designate any parking place as a coupon parking place by placing or erecting at or near such parking place a sign in accordance with any of the diagrams set out in the First Schedule.
(2) No person shall place or erect any sign at any parking place without the prior written consent of the Superintendent.

heading.en: Method of display of parking coupons

text.en:
6.—(1) As soon as a motor vehicle is parked in a coupon parking place, the driver of the vehicle shall —
(a)where a coupon in any of the Forms 1 to 4 in the Second Schedule is used, display one or more of the coupons on the front windscreen, front dashboard or front window of the motor vehicle in such a manner that the entire coupon is clearly visible for inspection at all times from outside the vehicle and the coupon shall have the date, time of commencement of parking of the vehicle and other particulars indicated therein in accordance with rule 7;
(b)where a coupon in Form 5 in the Second Schedule is used, display the coupon on the front windscreen of the motor vehicle in such a manner that the entire coupon is clearly visible for inspection at all times from outside the vehicle and the coupon shall have the date of parking the vehicle indicated therein in accordance with rule 7, the vehicle number of the motor car and the signature of a person authorised by the Superintendent to issue the coupon; and
(c)where a coupon in Form 6 in the Second Schedule is used, display the coupon in a conspicuous position on the motor cycle in such a manner that the entire coupon is clearly visible for inspection.
(2) Notwithstanding paragraph (1)(a), where the vehicle is a motor cycle, motor scooter or other similar vehicle, the driver may display the coupon in a conspicuous and visible position on the motor cycle, motor scooter or vehicle.

7. The date and time of commencement of parking a vehicle in a coupon parking place shall, where required to be indicated in the coupon by these Rules, be indicated in the coupon in accordance with the instructions given in the form in which the coupon is set out in the Second Schedule.

8. Where 2 or more coupons are displayed on a vehicle to cover the period during which the vehicle is to be parked in a coupon parking place, the time of commencement indicated in the second and subsequent coupon or coupons shall run immediately after the time of expiry of the period of parking indicated in the coupon of the prior period of parking.
9. The Superintendent or any person authorised by him in that behalf may issue to any person a coupon or coupons upon payment of the appropriate fees.

10. No refund shall be allowed for any unused coupons except in such special circumstances as the Superintendent may allow and provided that the coupons are not defaced, mutilated or in any other manner invalid.

11. No person shall display or cause or permit to be displayed on a vehicle a coupon in which the time of commencement of parking indicated thereon is later than the actual time when he parks the vehicle.

heading.en: Coupons that have been tampered with

text.en: 12. No person shall display or cause to be displayed on a vehicle any parking coupon that has any alteration, erasure or other irregularity therein which indicates that the coupon has been tampered with.

heading.en: Offence to continue parking with expired coupons

text.en:
13. Any person who continues to park in a coupon parking place after the expiry of the period in respect of which coupons are displayed on the vehicle to meet the parking charges shall be guilty of an offence.
[S 278/2018 wef 01/05/2018]

14.—(1) The Superintendent or any person authorised by him may for the purposes of these Rules require any driver of a vehicle parked in any coupon parking place to produce for his inspection any parking coupon or coupons displayed on such vehicle and may retain any such parking coupon.
(2) If the driver of the vehicle fails to produce the parking coupon or coupons displayed for inspection or retention by the Superintendent or any person authorised by him, he shall be guilty of an offence.

heading.en: Rules disapplied to the extent other payment method is used

text.en:
15. Rules 4, 6, 8, 11 and 13 do not apply to —
(a)a person who parks a vehicle in a coupon parking place who pays, in accordance with the method described in rule 4 or 4A of the Parking Places (Digital Payment — Parking Charges) Rules 2022 (as the case may be), the parking charge for the whole of the period, or a part of the period, the vehicle is so parked or intended to be so parked; and
[S 278/2018 wef 01/05/2018]
[S 530/2026 wef 03/08/2026]
(b)the period the parking charge for which is paid in accordance with the method described in rule 4 or 4A of the Parking Places (Digital Payment — Parking Charges) Rules 2022, as the case may be.
[S 554/2017 wef 03/10/2017]
[S 278/2018 wef 01/05/2018]
[S 530/2026 wef 03/08/2026]

SECOND SCHEDULE
Rules 4, 6 and 7
FORM 1
MOTOR CAR PARKING COUPON
1. The date (year, month and day) and time of commencement of parking shall be indicated on the parking coupon by tearing out completely the appropriate tabs (as shown in Sample).
2. Where 2 or more parking coupons are displayed, the time of commencement of parking for the second and subsequent coupons shall be immediately after the time of expiry of the period of parking covered by the previous coupon.
3. If no tab is provided for the time in minutes, it may be rounded upwards to the next 5 minutes.
FORM 2
MOTOR CAR PARKING COUPON
1. The date (year, month and day) and time of commencement of parking shall be indicated on the parking coupon by tearing out completely the appropriate tabs (as shown in Sample).
2. Where 2 or more parking coupons are displayed, the time of commencement of parking for the second and subsequent coupons shall be immediately after the time of expiry of the period of parking covered by the previous coupon.
3. If no tab is provided for the time in minutes, it may be rounded upwards to the next 5 minutes.
FORM 3
MOTOR CAR NIGHT PARKING COUPON
The date (year, month and day) and time of commencement of parking shall be indicated on the parking coupon by tearing out completely the appropriate tabs (as shown in Sample).
FORM 4
MOTOR CAR WHOLE DAY PARKING COUPON
The date (year, month and day) of parking shall be indicated on the parking coupon by tearing out completely the appropriate tabs (as shown in Sample).
FORM 5
MOTOR CAR MONTHLY PARKING COUPON
1. The date (year and month) of parking shall be indicated by tearing out completely the appropriate tabs (as shown in Sample).
2. The vehicle number shall be written in ink on the parking coupon in the space provided therein.
3. The officer issuing the parking coupon to sign and indicate the date of issue.
FORM 6
MOTOR CYCLE PARKING COUPON
1. The time (day or night) and date (year, month and day) of parking shall be indicated on the parking coupon by tearing out completely the appropriate tabs (as shown in Sample).
2. The vehicle number shall be written in ink on the parking coupon in the space provided therein.
